results.snippet: # US 10-Year Treasury Yield. The US 10-Year Treasury yield is arguably the most important interest rate in global finance. It represents the yield on US government debt with a 10-year maturity and serves as the global benchmark risk-free rate, influencing everything from mortgage rates to corporate bond pricing to emerging market capital flows. For Indian markets, the US 10Y yield is critical because rising US yields attract capital away from emerging markets (including India), weaken the rupee, and pressure FPI flows. Title: 10-year TIPS reopening auction gets real yield of 1.734% to weak demand | Treasury Inflation-Protected Securities
## 10-year TIPS reopening auction gets real yield of 1.734% to weak demand. One day after the Federal Reserve acted to lower short-term interest rates, the Treasury’s offering of $19 billion in a reopened 10-year Treasury Inflation-Protected Security — CUSIP 91282CNS6 — drew surprisingly weak demand from investors. The auctioned real yield to maturity for this 9-year, 10-month TIPS ended up at 1.734%, well above the “when-issued” market prediction of 1.684%. This TIPS had been trading on the secondary market with a real yield of 1.69% just before the auction’s close.
